headline: Ideas become outcomes.
thesis: I work where technology meets business strategy, studying how ideas turn into practical solutions and what it takes to carry them all the way to outcomes.
bio: Jithendra Sai Kilaru works where technology meets business. A computer science graduate of SRM University AP, he works in the Founder's Office at openCT, running operations and supporting the founder on outreach and timelines. Before that he spent his university years inside startups and SRM's innovation and entrepreneurship programs, in operations, data and people roles. Every week he writes Rising Ideas, analysis of technology, business and geopolitics for more than 900 subscribers.
